title: SWERepo never answers SeamSpec's consent, and runs seamspec init only in a terminal
assertion: With a fake `seamspec` first on PATH that logs every call, in a git repository with a pyproject.toml and a uv.lock, and with the command line seeing a terminal: `swerepo init --yes`, `swerepo init --dry-run` and `swerepo init --json` run no `seamspec init`; the `--yes` run applies the other default components (docs, agents, ci, security and github are recorded, and their files written) and says to run `seamspec init` in a terminal. An interactive `swerepo init --only seamspec` answered yes runs `seamspec init` once, and `seamspec review` only when the person answers yes to reviewing the proposals. After a newer SeamSpec is installed, `swerepo update --yes` runs no `seamspec init`, and an interactive `swerepo update` answered yes reruns it once. No call SWERepo makes to `seamspec` ever passes an argument starting with `--accept-auto-run`.

origin.text: ADR-20261124-cd64 point 1 (the owner's choice, 2026-11-24): SeamSpec's consent is the person's, so seamspec init runs only in their terminal and never with --accept-auto-run; --yes never answers it. Tightened twice after SeamSpec's reviewer: the command line with a terminal, the fake on PATH, any --accept-auto-run form, what --yes applies, and the review only on a yes.
